Name: Weapons Retextures Anytime
Author: breeshlean
Description:
[size=3][u][b]DESCRIPTION

[/b][/u][color=#e69138]NOTE: I have stepped away from modding for a while.  This mod exists as is and won't be updated.[/color][/size][color=#e69138][size=3]
[/size][/color][size=3]
Updated for 1.6.

This Content Patcher pack allows you to re-texture any vanilla weapon into any another weapon of the same category [b]without [/b]using the Volcano Forge.  From the very beginning you can make your weapon look like another.  The pack includes all base game weapons,1.6 weapon additions, and a bunch of new looks.[u][b]

[/b][/u][b][u]CREDITS

[/u][/b]Thanks to 1am1337 for the lightsaber idea.
Thanks to zcsnightmare for the inspiration to create a mod.
Witchy Weapons inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24109]BogWyytch[/url].
[u][b]
INITIAL USE

[/b][/u]1) This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].  Install these first.

2) Unzip this mod's files into the Mods folder. 

3) Run the game to generate a config file for the mod.

4) Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]﻿to make your choices.  It is much, much easier that way.  Or you could edit the config file directly.
﻿- [size=3]From GMCM, find the weapon your character is currently carrying.  Using the drop-down menu, choose the ﻿weapon that you want your current weapon to look like.[/size]

[u][b]UPDATES

[/b][/u]When updating this mod, delete the previous version from your Mods folder and drop in the new version.

[u][b][color=#ff0000]**ATTENTION**[/color]
[/b][/u]
It appears that the mod's re-textures will not be applied to weapons that have already been re-textured in the Volcano Forge.  The Forge texture takes precedence.
[/size]
